limitations: One isolated headless Linux Chromium profile at390×844, Classic/Feyz. No user profile, recordings or microphone is accessed. Service workers and external fonts are blocked by the common engineering fixture.

The shipped128-second Ayatul MP3 is copied into isolated koruma:3 and koruma:4 personal slots solely as a transport-test alias. It does not represent Kalem recitation content. A generated3-second PCM WAV is a separate isolated short-source input.

Selection and transport use public production session APIs with actual native HTMLMediaElement playback and measured media clocks. Visibility changes are simulated with document.hidden/visibilityState getters and visibilitychange events; physical Android locking, OS focus and audible output are not measured.

Only the short-source case deliberately replaces the two optional FX/cadence preparation functions with null-returning test boundaries, then restores them. Native playback, metadata, media time, loop observations and counters remain real production behavior.
The failure-card cases explicitly inject a controlled recording-failure object after playback is stopped to verify matching selected-session presentation and actual message text.
